messages:
zoe (design): quick note from testing: empty rules + filtered view is confusing. users think the preview area is unrelated.
mark (pm): can we show clearer guidance + actions? propose: title 'No rules match' + 'Clear filters' and primary 'Create rule' CTA. also show which filters are active.
owen (frontend): yep. avoid layout jumps by reserving min-height for the list. i'll render a compact placeholder card rather than removing the list container. small perf ask: keep svg footprint tiny.
rita (a11y): a11y checklist: polite live region for "0 rules match. filters: env=prod". for reorder failures use role=alert and focus it so SRs catch it. add sr-only reorder instructions: "press space to lift, arrow keys to move".
zoe (design): preview area: instead of dimming let's show a subtle centered card: 'Preview unavailable' + reason + actions 'Select snapshot' / 'Create snapshot'. keep background simulation faint so users understand placement.
mark (pm): decision: update empty-state copy + show active filters (owner zoe), reserve list height (owen), overlay card for preview (zoe+owen), live region & alert patterns (rita). i'll add tickets.
owen (frontend): i'll add storybook stories (empty-state, preview-card, reorder-fail) and include test attrs. ETA Fri.
ui-test-bot: test run queued for branch feature/routing-emptystate — status: queued.
rita (a11y): i'll review PR for focus order and live region wording.
zoe (design): thanks — i'll drop mocks in the doc and include two copy variants for localization.
